cluster: k3s 1.34 on hydra-olympus-1 and hydra-olympus-2; backend, frontend, MinIO on hydra-olympus-2; two CNPG instances, one per node
workload: 179 explorers and 77 painters, 512 authenticated WebSockets through Traefik, Box Art fixture on eight tiles, five-second client deadline
driver: scripts/test-helm-stack.mjs from the devbox athena-hephaestus with CAELESTIS_TEST_EXTENDED, CAELESTIS_TEST_STORAGE=s3, CAELESTIS_TEST_BENCHMARK
verdict: Bun passes the strict 256-user run on the final images; Node still misses the five-second deadline during warmup. Classification, decoding, artifacts, and folds are no longer measurable; the remaining wait on both runtimes is the serialized owner connection in the Postgres adapter.
